biotools.summary: Process and predict mapping of species abundance data. The package automates and greatly simplifies Boosted Regression Tree spatial modelling and makes this powerful statistical modelling technique more accessible to potential users in the ecological and modelling communities.
biotools.name: gbm.auto

metadata.abstract: The subheading “Worked examplePre-run parameter scoping with gbm.bfcheck” under the Guide to software functions section is incorrect. The subheadings should be “Worked example” and “Pre-run parameter scoping with gbm.bfcheck”. The following information is missing from the eighth paragraph of the Guide to software functions section under the subheading “Worked example”: To demonstrate gbm.auto we will run a simple example in the sections below; here we load the required functions and data. Please see Supplementary Material D1 for all details of each function and more fully worked examples. install.packages("devtools") library("devtools") install_github(’SimonDedman/gbm.auto’) library("gbm.auto") mygrids <- gbm.auto::grids # load grids mysamples <- gbm.auto::samples # load samples
metadata.title: Correction: Gbm.auto: A software tool to simplify spatial modelling and Marine Protected Area planning (PLoS ONE (2017) 12:12 (e0188955) DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0188955)
